items.title: Surge Arresters for Delhi Metro Rail Corporation
items.description: SIPS awarded a Contract: OEW-1995 – "Supply, Installation, Testing and Commissioning of Phase to Phase to Ground Metal oxide Surge Arresters in Dry type auxiliary transformer of ASS of Delhi Metro Rail Corporation Ltd."

items.title: Extension of 765/400KV Champa S/S
items.description: SIPS awarded a work of Extension of 765/400KV Champa S/S (for Installation of 1x240MVAR, 765KV Bus Reactor & 1x125MVAR, 420 KV Bus Reactor at Champa PS (on bus Section-A where Lara I project is connected) under Transmission Scheme to control high voltage at Champa PS (On Bus Section-A, where Lara TPS -I (2x800MW) of NTPC is connected).

items.title: 400 KV Substation Package at Jhatikra
items.description: SIPS awarded a contract for Supply of Service Contract for Substation Package SS-01 for Construction of additional 400 KV dia towards Mundka section at Jhatikra substation. Specification No. NR1/NT/W-CB/DOM/100/25/08207 (RFX-5002004558) Domestic Competitive Bidding (Project Funding: Domestic).

items.title: Meter Data Downloading & Bill Distribution – TPCODL
items.description: SIPS awarded a contract for Meter Data Downloading Through CMRI & Non CMRI, Bill Printing, Bill Distribution and Site Verification of Permanent Disconnected Three Phase Consumers at TPSODL for LOI-2 (Bhanjanagar Circle), LOI-3 (Berhampur Circle) and LOI-6 (NED Division).

items.title: 11 KV & LT Network Maintenance – TPCODL
items.description: SIPS awarded a contract for Letter of Intent for 11 KV & LT Network Maintenance & Allied Work, 33 KV Network Maintenance and Operational Assistance of 33/11 KV Sub-Stations of TPCODL with one year of validity.

items.title: OHE Modification at Duffrin Bridge – Northern Railway
items.description: SIPS awarded a contract for Modification required in existing OHE arrangement for conversion of 1 X 25 KV OHE system to 2 X 25 KV OHE system in NDLS-CPYZ section of Delhi sub-urban area of Delhi division/N.Rly, including design, supply, erection testing & commissioning of SSP at Duffrin Bridge in connection with raising the speed to 160 kmph.

items.title: Library Building & Gate Complex – IGIT Sarang
items.description: SIPS awarded a contract for Construction of Library Building, Main Gate Complex & Hostel Side Gate at Indira Gandhi Institute Technology (IGIT) Sarang, Dhenkanal.

items.title: Meter Installation – BCDD-1 Division TPCODL
items.description: SIPS awarded a contract for Rate Contract for Meter Installation and Associated Services in BCDD-1 Division of TPCODL for 1st year.

items.title: Meter Reading & Spot Billing – TPCODL
items.description: SIPS awarded a contract for Rate Contract for Meter Reading cum Spot Billing/Bill Distribution Door to Door Collection and Disconnection Squad at TPCODL Division: TED.

items.title: Copper Cable in Elevated Section – DMRC
items.description: SIPS awarded a contract for EOM/2024 01 Supply & Laying of 142 km Aluminium cables including removal of copper cable in elevated section of DMRC.

items.title: 400kV Ranchi Substation Extension – PGCIL
items.description: SIPS awarded a contract for Substation Package SS-121 for (a) Extension of 400kV Ranchi (PG) substation including transmission line works and (b) Extension of 400kV Ranchi (New) substation under Eastern Region.

items.title: 33KV, 11KV and 1.1 KV Works – TPSODL
items.description: SIPS awarded a contract for 33KV, 11KV and 1.1 KV Associated Works (Construction/Augmentation) in TPSODL for Releasing New HT and LT Connection & Distribution Electrical works.

items.title: OHE Upgradation – BSP-CPH Section
items.description: SIPS awarded a contract for Upgradation of Existing OHE to 2 x 25kv AT Feeder system between BSP-CPH section of Bilaspur Division By South East Central Railway.

items.title: Railway Formation Work – South Eastern Railway
items.description: SIPS awarded a contract for Execution of earthwork in cutting & filling for making of Railway formation work including blanketing, extension of minor bridges, supply of cess ballast, p. way works, execution of protection works, diversion road works, transportation, supply of p. way fitting and others miscellaneous works between (Km: 414.734 to Km: 417.455) of Rourkela-Panposh section for extension of Birmitrapur line upto Rourkela Yard under the jurisdiction of Dy CE/Con/Jharsuguda in Chakradharpur division by South Eastern Railway.

items.title: 1×25 kV Transmission Line Upgradation
items.description: Shyam Indus Power Solutions Pvt Ltd awarded a contract for Design, Supply, Erection, Testing & Commissioning for upgradation of existing 1×25 kV system.

items.title: 765kV Transmission Line – Western Region
items.description: SIPS awarded a turnkey contract for the construction of 765kV Single Circuit Transmission Line (Package TL-07) covering a stretch of approximately 180 km route length in the Western Region of India under ISTS scheme.

items.title: 33/11 KV Substation Construction – TPCODL
items.description: SIPS awarded a contract for Construction of new 33/11 KV Indoor Substation with 2x10 MVA Power Transformer and associated HT/LT distribution network in TPCODL operational area.

items.title: Warehouse Construction – MPWLC
items.description: SIPS awarded a contract for Construction of Warehouses, roads, water pipelines and ancillary civil works for MP Warehousing & Logistic Corporation (MPWLC) at multiple locations in Madhya Pradesh.

items.title: OHE Works – North Eastern Railway
items.description: SIPS awarded a contract for Supply, Installation, Testing and Commissioning of 25kV AC Overhead Electrification works in the North Eastern Railway zone covering approximately 120 Route Km.

items.title: 400kV GIS Substation – Northern Region
items.description: SIPS awarded a contract for Supply, Erection, Testing and Commissioning of 400kV GIS substation package under Northern Region Strengthening Scheme – Phase IV.

items.title: 220kV Transmission Line – Eastern Region
items.description: SIPS awarded a turnkey contract for construction of 220kV Double Circuit Transmission Line including tower fabrication, erection, stringing, and commissioning in the Eastern Region.
